title: Letterhead · US Letter specifications
slide_intent: Allocate a letter’s margins to its sender, message and institutional details. A predictable hierarchy lets the recipient find the sender without interrupting the body copy.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can preserve its identity in formal US correspondence with a compact upper-right mark and a distinct contact footer.
demonstration: The US Letter specimen connects five numbered notes to the mark, body, contact block and accreditation. Circular details enlarge the smallest type.
practical_value: For an 8.5 × 11 inch letter, use 22 mm side margins, a 42 mm top margin and a 28 mm body bottom margin. Position the mark 13 mm from the top and right edges.

content_islands.name: Format table
content_islands.spec: Place format, stocks, colors and margins in a ruled table at left. Follow it with numbered type and placement settings.

content_islands.name: Annotated letter
content_islands.spec: Center the full letter on a pale field. Use guide lines and numbered dots at the mark, then magnify body text, contact details and small accreditation type in circles.
